question: Should workflow integrations use the existing typed plugin `session_end` lifecycle hook, or should OpenClaw add a separate internal `session:end` hook event?
rationale: Both surfaces can support completion automation, but adding an internal event expands the operator hook API while the typed plugin hook is already the documented lifecycle contract.

options.title: Bless plugin session_end
options.body: Document typed plugin `session_end` as the supported completion hook for workflow integrations and close or retitle this issue once that direction is visible.

options.title: Approve internal session:end
options.body: Define a narrow internal hook payload and wire it consistently across reset, delete, shutdown/restart, cron/webhook, and subagent paths.

options.title: Wait for linked PR review
options.body: Keep this issue open until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/61675 is landed or closed, then reassess the remaining internal-hook gap.

recommendation.title: Bless plugin session_end
recommendation.body: Document typed plugin `session_end` as the supported completion hook for workflow integrations and close or retitle this issue once that direction is visible.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining choice is primarily a hooks/plugin API-boundary decision and recent history plus PR discussion route that surface to this handle.
